messages:
liz: small thread 1717 Benchmark narrative for launch 1717 need: 1) hero chart format decision, 2) copy that doesn't read like a price list, 3) downloadable data + CTA split. quick ideas below.

ben: paste the numbers you want surfaced and i'll produce a normalized index + p95 inset. avoid raw $ claims.

liz: toy dataset (for mockups):
```
model,median_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k
Redwood-Serve,95,210,0.11
OpenFast,210,680,0.04
QuantPro,150,260,0.07
```

rita: two visual options: A) stacked bars showing tokens-per-$ + thin overlay line p95; B) scatter grid (latency vs cost) with quadrant labels (low latency + low cost is sweetspot). B feels more 'analytical' but A is digestible at glance.

omar: recommend A for landing hero (tokens-per-$) and B in a "how we measured" deep dive. emphasize "predictable p95" in subhead not "cheapest".

noah: routing/Cta split: Devs -> "Try in 5 mins" (self-serve); Infra/Platform -> "Schedule architecture review" (form + AE). Also add a downloadable CSV + PNG link on the chart 17 helps trust.

ben: I'll create an indexed chart (Redwood = 1.0) and a small p95 distribution inset for each model. i'll also include a one-line methodology blurb: "Synthetic service workload; batching=on; KV cache enabled; see appendix."

liz: hero copy options: "Predictable token economics for production" vs "Less $ per token, more predictable latency." which lands better?

rita: first is cleaner for ops audience; second is punchier for webinar promos.

omar: webinar tagline suggestion: "How we reduce inference cost and tame tail latency" 17 short bullets: problem, approach (routing + batching + quant profiles), outcome. 30s teaser ready.

noah: for ad copy (short): "Reduce inference spend. Keep latency predictable. Join our webinar." CTA: "Save my spot" or "Start free" depending on route.

ci-bot: CI note: asset-build job queued for charts. https://ci.internal/redwood/asset-build/7890

liz: next steps: ben -> normalized PNG + CSV + p95 inset by Thu noon; rita -> hero + deep-dive mockups by Thu EOD; noah -> two CTA variants + ad microcopy; omar -> 1-paragraph methodology. reconvene Fri AM to finalize. thanks :rocket:
